_readme: Art style presets. 'guided_walk': false makes the walk use pose words instead of a drawn pose puppet: needed when the model hands the puppet back unchanged, or the walk frames otherwise miss the drawn pose (measured on pixel art, flat cartoon, 8-bit pixel art, watercolor storybook, manga, cel-shaded outline, retro sci-fi pulp and dark gothic painting). This is not simply 'flat-shaded styles fail': comic, anime, chibi and voxel art are flat-shaded or blocky too and all kept the puppet when checked; conversely watercolor and manga are painterly/linework styles, the kind that usually keeps the puppet, and both lost it anyway (see docs/animation.md, round 4). Check any new style on a real GPU run (a 4-frame side walk is enough) before trusting either setting, and look at the frames: a handed-back puppet passes the pose checks (docs/animation.md, round 5). Add a new style by copying an entry: 'style' and 'negative' go into the Mage-Flow prompt, 'edit_name' is how the style is named when editing from the portrait, 'backdrop' is the portrait background when transparency is off, 'hard_edges' turns off edge softening when cutting out sprites, 'use_heritage' adds 'of X descent' to the prompt.
